label: Teacher Portal
seo_description: Attendance, marks, syllabus signals, assignments, and guardian messaging connected.
headline: One classroom workspace for attendance, marks, assignments, and progress.
subheadline: Plan the day, take attendance, capture marks, assign work, track lesson coverage, keep student notes, and reach families—with policies that respect what each role should see.

segments.title: Day-one usability
segments.body: Registers and marks entry surfaced for real class blocks—not buried five clicks deep.

segments.title: Guardian alignment
segments.body: Messaging respects visibility policies tied to the same records parents see.

segments.title: Insight-ready
segments.body: Signals leadership needs without every teacher becoming a reporting clerk.

problem_section.title: Teachers need one daily workspace
problem_section.body: Switching tools for attendance, marks, assignments, and communication burns time. RunMyCampus centralizes classroom operations with role-aware visibility.

bullets: Fewer disconnected tabs during prep and between periods
Notes and outreach aligned to students in context
Less variance in how marks and attendance are captured
Operational visibility without micromanaging every classroom
Adoption signals when your deployment instruments them
Updates originate from the same system of record as the portal
Less conflicting information across informal channels
Support load drops when the teacher workspace is coherent
